caseName: Watson v. Employers Liability Assurance Corp.
caseNameFull: Watson et ux. v. Employers Liability Assurance Corp., Ltd.
attorneys: Val Irion for appellants-petitioners., Charles D. Egan for appellees-respondents.

opinions.text: Appeal from and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit. Further consideration of the question of the jurisdiction of this Court in this case on appeal is postponed to the hearing of the case on the merits. The petition for writ of certiorari is granted.
